en.headline: sogeisetsu lands 6 commits: batching, 0.2.0 release, 797-entry glossary
en.summary: On 2026-10-23 the user made **6 own commits** across `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, plus 11 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sopen-translate`, page performance work added provider-policy batching, bounded concurrency and adaptive splitting. Options and popup fixes kept the model cache TTL honest and guarded the restore status fetch, and the glossary shipped an offline-built builtin term list with 797 entries. Housekeeping included ignoring locally installed agent skills and recording C6 real-device acceptance results in the plan docs. A release chore bumped the project to 0.2.0 and synced docs with the bilingual/glossary work. No pull requests, reviews, issues, discussions or stars were recorded, and no collection section hit its cap.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 完成 6 次提交：批处理、0.2.0 与 797 条术语表
zh.summary: 2026-10-23，用户在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 完成 **6 次本人提交**，另有 11 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的自动提交。`sopen-translate` 的页面性能工作加入了按服务商策略批处理、有界并发与自适应拆分。选项与弹窗修复让模型缓存 TTL 更准确，并为恢复状态请求加了保护；术语表则上线了离线构建的内置词条列表，共 797 条。杂项工作包括忽略本地安装的 agent skills，并在计划文档中记录 C6 真机验收结果。发布相关提交将版本提升至 0.2.0，并让文档与双语/术语表工作保持一致。当天没有 pull request、review、issue、discussion 或 star 记录，且各采集区块均未触及上限。
